headline: Markolines Pavement Technologies wins Rs 135 crore BMC road contract
hook: BMC awards Rs 135 crore road contract
summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies has secured work orders from the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for road resurfacing projects. The contract involves using microsurfacing technology on the Eastern and Western Express Highways in Mumbai. The total value of these orders is approximately Rs 135.20 crore. This project adds to the company's order book for infrastructure maintenance services.
why_it_matters: Revenue visibility improves for the infrastructure maintenance firm.

headline: Markolines secures ₹135 crore BMC road resurfacing contract
hook: Major road maintenance contract for Markolines
summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies has been awarded a ₹135 crore contract by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC). The project involves the resurfacing of Mumbai's key arterial roads, specifically the Eastern and Western Express Highways. This order adds to the company's existing infrastructure project pipeline in the Mumbai metropolitan region.
why_it_matters: Revenue visibility improves for the infrastructure firm
winners_losers: Markolines gains / BMC taxpayers bear cost

headline: Markolines Pavement Technologies secures BMC orders for Mumbai highway microsurfacing
hook: Two highway contracts worth Rs 135 crore
summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies has received two Letters of Acceptance-cum-Work Orders from the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC). The contracts involve undertaking microsurfacing works on the Eastern Express Highway and Western Express Highway in Mumbai. The total value of the two aggregated orders stands at Rs 135.20 crores. Retail investors should track order execution timelines and revenue recognition as these large municipal projects contribute to the company's order book.
why_it_matters: Order book expands by Rs 135.20 crore from BMC projects
